intro: These two are live auctions. They are separate from the cards I already own, and they stay out of the paid and value totals.
The Dream lead the Liberty 2-0 in the semifinals. Her playoff scoring has gone 13, 15, 17, then 23, and Game 3 is Friday, Oct. 9, at Barclays Center. The Finals are still in front of them.

bids.card: 2024 Panini Prizm WNBA Gold Vinyl Prizm #147 Angel Reese Rookie
bids.cert_note: Cert 146338722 is printed on the slab and on the Goldin lot.
bids.ends_note: Extended bidding runs in 30-minute intervals after 7:00 p.m. PT. Goldin lists that window as 10:00 p.m. ET on Oct 17, 2026.
bids.estimate_note: No sale of this #147 Gold Vinyl 1/1 turned up. The low is the live $2,750 bid, with more than a week left and two bids in. The high stays at $6,000: the closest 1/1s are Reese's Groovy Gold Vinyl PSA 9 at $1,403 and a Rickea Jackson Groovy Gold Vinyl PSA 10 at $3,200, and this copy is a PSA 8. Clark's Gold Vinyl 1/1 is a different market and is left out. Sports Card Investor lists $675 for the same Oct 2, 2025 Kaleidoscopic sale that SportsCardsPro lists at $1,199, so that comp is soft.

image.alt: 2024 Panini Prizm WNBA Gold Vinyl Prizm number 147 Angel Reese rookie card, serial 1 of 1, in a PSA NM-MT 8 slab labeled certification 146338722

bids.take: I'm bidding on the 1/1 Gold Vinyl of her Prizm rookie, #147, in a PSA 8. No sale of this exact card has turned up, so I'm keeping a wide range with the live bid as the floor. Her playoff scoring has gone 13, 15, 17, then 23, and the Dream lead the Liberty 2-0 with Game 3 on Friday at Barclays Center. If Atlanta reaches the Finals, this one-of-one can still move, and the PSA 8 is what holds the top of the range down.

bids.cert_note: Cert 139024135 is printed on the slab. PSA's public cert page did not load, so the number is not confirmed there.

bids.bids_note: Alt showed $982 from WP*** and $957 from ZZ***.
bids.ends_note: The end time is not on the public listing while logged out, and Alt's page data did not include it.
bids.estimate_note: The high is the only verified sale of this Gold /10: $6,900 with buyer's premium for an authenticated raw 1/10 on Fanatics Collect, sold Aug 25, 2025. The low sits near the live $982 bid and the recent base Kaboom PSA 10 sales ($975 and $1,500), because no PSA 10 of the Gold has a recorded sale and this auction can still finish close to where it is. The range is wide on purpose. Alt's fees were not on the public listing. A $9,000 figure dated July 29, 2025 shows up on Sports Card Investor without a venue, so it is left out.

image.alt: 2024 Panini Instant Rookie Royalty WNBA Kaboom Gold number 5 Angel Reese rookie card, serial 01 of 10, in a PSA Gem Mint 10 slab labeled certification 139024135

bids.take: I'm bidding on the Gold Kaboom, serial 01/10, in a PSA 10. I already have two base Kabooms in gem mint, and this is the numbered one. A raw 1/10 sold for $6,900 with buyer's premium in August 2025, the base PSA 10 has been closer to $1,000 this year, and the live bid is still $982. If the Dream reach the Finals, the gem of the /10 can separate from the base, and if the series ends Friday that 2025 sale is a long way from this auction.
